summary: Learn to automate monthly, quarterly, and donor reporting with Excel, Power BI, and workflow tools. Build practical controls and report packs.
lede: Reporting automation helps operations, finance, and programme reporting teams turn recurring data into controlled, repeatable reports. This course covers preparing and validating data with Excel and Power Query, reconciling figures, building Power BI dashboards, and managing approval workflows. Learners practise producing standard report packs, tracking exceptions and approvals, and applying human checks where automation is unsuitable.
audienceIntro: Reporting automation is suited to professionals who prepare, validate, review, approve, or interpret recurring programme, financial, and operational reports. It is especially relevant when you need to improve reporting reliability while working with Excel, Power BI, and workflow tools rather than custom software. This course is designed for: M&E Officers maintaining indicator data, results frameworks, and donor evidence. Reporting Officers assembling monthly and quarterly management report packs. Finance Analysts reconciling budgets, actuals, forecasts, and programme expenditure. Operations Analysts consolidating activity, service delivery, and resource data. Project Managers coordinating reporting calendars, reviews, and corrective actions. Programme Managers reviewing results, exceptions, and implementation progress. Donor Reporting Specialists standardising narrative and financial submissions. Data Quality Officers applying validation rules and resolving reporting anomalies. Power BI Analysts developing dashboards for programme and financial performance. Internal Audit and Compliance Analysts checking reporting controls and approval trails.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience preparing or reviewing Excel-based monthly, quarterly, programme, finance, or donor reports. Basic Excel skills, including formulas, tables, filters, and charts, are expected. No programming or software engineering experience is required. Familiarity with Power BI is helpful but not essential because the course introduces the required modelling and dashboard concepts before guided practice. Bring a laptop with access to Excel and Power BI Desktop where organisational policy permits. Power Automate and SharePoint exercises can use a provided demonstration environment or digital templates, subject to licence availability.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
